name: ComptaFlow by MeeTempo – French Accounting for WordPress
author: meetempo

sections.description:
The only WordPress plugin built for French accounting standards (PCG).

ComptaFlow by MeeTempo is a free accounting assistant designed specifically for France: freelancers, auto-entrepreneurs, SASU, EURL, and small businesses. Enter your daily transactions with a guided system that automatically suggests the right PCG accounts and generates proper double-entry journal entries. Fully compliant with French tax requirements.

Why ComptaFlow by MeeTempo?

✅ Guided Entry: PCG accounts are automatically suggested (type “fuel” → 6061, “lawyer” → 6226)

✅ Automatic Journal Entries: Double-entry bookkeeping generated automatically

✅ French Chart of Accounts: 200+ pre-configured PCG accounts

✅ Multiple Exports: Balance Sheet, General Ledger, Journal, Income Statement

✅ VAT Tracking: Monitor your VAT for CA3 or CA12 regimes

Features (Free Version)

  • Invoicing – Create, edit, validate, duplicate invoices with PDF generation
  • Client management – Full CRUD with statistics per client
  • Unlimited income and expense entries
  • Automatic journal entries following French accounting standards
  • French Chart of Accounts (PCG) with 200+ pre-configured accounts
  • Financial operations (bank transfers, loans, capital)
  • Manual journal entries for adjustments (OD)
  • CSV Exports: Balance Sheet, General Ledger, Journal, Income Statement
  • VAT rate management with multiple rates support
  • Backup and restore functionality
  • Company settings (SIRET, VAT number, fiscal year)

The Right Workflow

  1. Daily: Enter your income and expenses with the guided system
  2. Weekly: Review your journal entries and correct if needed
  3. Monthly: Export your reports and track your VAT
  4. Year-End: Send your exports to your accountant for validation

Who Is This For?

  • French freelancers and consultants (profession libérale, BNC, BIC)
  • Auto-entrepreneurs & micro-entrepreneurs preparing for “régime réel”
  • SASU / SAS / EURL / SARL owners
  • Small businesses in France up to 10 employees
  • Anyone who needs PCG-compliant bookkeeping in WordPress

⚠️ Important: This plugin is built exclusively for French accounting standards (Plan Comptable Général). It is not suitable for US, UK, or other countries’ accounting systems.

ComptaFlow Pro

Need advanced features? ComptaFlow Pro adds:

  • 📄 Full Invoicing – Invoices, Quotes, Credit Notes with PDF generation
  • 🔍 SIRET API – Auto-fill company and client info from official database
  • 📤 FEC Export – DGFiP-compliant file for tax audits
  • 🏦 Bank Reconciliation – Multi-bank CSV import with intelligent matching
  • 📋 VAT Management – CA3/CA12 automatic declarations
  • 🏢 Fixed Assets – Depreciation schedules and asset management
  • 💰 Payroll Tracking – Simplified salary and social charges entry
  • 📊 Liasse Fiscale 2031 – Tax return form generation
  • 📧 Client Reminders – Email & WhatsApp automatic payment reminders (VIP)
  • 🎯 Priority Support – Direct assistance from our team

🇫🇷 The Pro version is entirely in French – fully translated interface from installation.

Visit comptaflow.meetempo.com to learn more about ComptaFlow Pro.

Disclaimer

ComptaFlow by MeeTempo is an accounting entry assistance and data organization tool. It does not constitute certified accounting software, nor does it provide tax or legal advice. The user remains responsible for the accuracy of their accounting. We recommend having documents validated by a certified accountant before submitting them to tax authorities.

Privacy

This free version of ComptaFlow does not collect any data and makes no external API calls. All your accounting data remains exclusively in your WordPress database.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Access ComptaFlow in the WordPress admin menu
  5. Configure your company in Settings (SIRET, VAT regime, etc.)
  6. Start entering your transactions!
sections.faq:
Is this plugin for my country?

ComptaFlow is built exclusively for France and the French accounting system (Plan Comptable Général – PCG). If you are not based in France or do not follow French accounting standards, this plugin is not for you. It supports French VAT regimes (franchise en base, CA3, CA12), SIRET, and FEC export for DGFiP compliance.

Does this plugin replace an accountant?

No. ComptaFlow by MeeTempo is an accounting entry assistance tool. It helps you maintain your daily bookkeeping with a guided system. For annual validation, year-end closing, and official tax declarations, we recommend working with a certified accountant.

What exports are available in the free version?

The free version includes four CSV exports:
* Balance Sheet – Account balances for a period
* General Ledger – Detailed movements by account
* Journal – Chronological list of all entries
* Income Statement – Revenue and expenses summary

What is FEC and why isn’t it in the free version?

FEC (Fichier des Écritures Comptables) is a specific file format required by French tax authorities for audits. It requires strict compliance with Article A.47 A-1 LPF. This feature is available in ComptaFlow Pro to ensure full compliance and support.

Can I upgrade to Pro later?

Yes! Your data is fully compatible. Simply purchase ComptaFlow Pro from comptaflow.meetempo.com and install it. All your existing transactions and settings will be preserved.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All your accounting data stays in your WordPress database. The free version makes no external API calls. Your financial information never leaves your server.

Can I use the plugin as a micro-entrepreneur?

Yes. As a micro-entrepreneur, you don’t have full accounting obligations, but the plugin helps you track your income to avoid exceeding thresholds and prepare for a potential switch to “régime réel”.

What VAT regimes are supported?

The plugin supports:
* Franchise en base (VAT exempt)
* Régime réel normal (CA3 – monthly/quarterly)
* Régime réel simplifié (CA12 – annual with installments)
